as_told.title: Gravity control achieved in 1954, seen in vault documents

plain: The United States learned to control gravity in October 1954, according to documents a man named Richard Foch is said to have seen in a vault, linked to the Naval Research Laboratory, the Navy's science lab. Steven Greer, an activist who campaigns for UFO secrets to be made public, tells it from what Foch told him: "Rick had been in the vault and saw the documents for the date we mastered gravity control and it was October 1954." Michael Herrera, a former Marine who says he saw a huge craft in Indonesia, repeats it only through Greer, speaking of "one of his teammates" without naming Foch or giving the month, and both tell it to suggest a secret technology far beyond anything made public.
